goal: Single one-shot OFFLINE+public-GET same-venue 4h 1m reconstruction readiness check for BTCUSDT Spot Bitget and btc_usdt Spot LBank. This never substitutes for Bybit 4h/1m validation or any exchange execution.
window: The latest UTC-aligned 4-hour candle whose END is at least 2min before first public response at start of read. Anchor to device UTC before network calls, then do NOT move/retune if requested rows are missing.

venue_sources.time_1m: UTC selected 4h candle start minus 60 seconds
venue_sources.time_4h: UTC selected 4h candle start minus 4 hours

requirements.strict_1m_sequence: exactly 240 unique UTC minute opens every 60000ms within target 4h bar, no missing, duplicated, extra or unfinished minute
requirements.open_high_low_close_reconstruction: first O, max H, min L, final C
requirements.gate: A venue passes only if all 240 minute bars and target 4h bar are retrieved from that SAME venue, prices within 0.01 USD, and summed base volume within 0.1%; otherwise fail-closed with detailed discrepancy; no override.

source_receipts: Record public raw JSON, fetched timestamp UTC, raw byte SHA256, requested no-auth URL. No orders, no auth. Strictly receive completed bars; do not report 4h/1m pass based on cross-venue prices.
scope: Same-day historical quality only, not genuinely unseen forward validation; already observed timestamp; no trading-edge/Paper/DD/PNL claim. Due Bybit public 403 on both Windows machines, Bybit source-quality gate remains UNVERIFIED/FAILED regardless of Bitget/LBank result.
